title: 厄斐琉斯·月饼小碟
description: 深蓝发厄斐琉斯安静摆放月形小点心，月石武器放在身后架上，浅色月光点缀背景。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Aphelios is a quiet pale adult man with dark blue hair falling across one eye, a slender face, and intricate silver lunar ornaments. Keep his fitted dark Lunari uniform, high collar, long opaque coat panels, gloves, and boots recognizable. A few distinctive moonstone weapon forms rest securely together on a low stand, with no firing or combat stance.
art_direction.scene: He sits at a small moonlit table and arranges crescent-shaped cakes around one round saucer, concentrating on the spacing with a reserved gentle expression. A silver-blue window circle echoes the plate. Keep his free hand relaxed and the weapon stand clearly separate behind him, with broad paper margins and a quiet uncluttered room.
art_direction.palette: midnight blue, silver gray, moon cream, muted violet
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
